integrity: An analytic proof is supplied; the endpoint rational diagnostics are not substituted for proofs. Bibliographic completeness and independent validation are not asserted.
limitations: The ordinary property is classified for arbitrary index sets and 1<p<infinity; the uniform property equivalence is for finite sums only. No quantitative universal modulus or infinite-sum uniform closure is claimed.
title: Steinhaus permanence and its sharp exponent boundary for Banach direct sums
